title: Scheduler Runs Low-Priority Tasks First
description:
`order_tasks(tasks)` in `scheduler.py` should sort tasks so the **highest** priority number runs first. Right now it sorts lowest-priority-first instead. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Files**
`task.py` — the `Task` data class (`name`, `priority` where higher = more urgent)
`scheduler.py` — orders tasks for execution

**Function signature**
`order_tasks(tasks: list[Task]) -> list[Task]`
